skills.name: kritik
skills.description: Audit whether conclusions are authorized by a bounded corpus through exact evidence, sources, warrants, counterevidence, and inferential limits, and produce one durable markdown report.

skills.name: legion
skills.description: Convoke a council of diverse experts as independent sub-agents to analyze a problem from multiple perspectives and synthesize their outputs into a persisted .md dictamen.

skills.name: research
skills.description: Run staged web investigation and produce one durable paper-style markdown report with BibTeX-compatible references.
